meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后，服务会从 channels 分支复制并注册 Discord 适配器，安装固定版本依赖，构建并通过集成测试；之后需手动创建 Discord 机器人并粘贴 Token、重启服务，机器人即可在共享服务器上与你私信或收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说“接入 Discord”或“添加 Discord 频道”，或在 /setup 流程中需要连接 Discord 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接进来。
say.note: 自动复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试，然后提示你创建机器人。

say.text: 我要启用 Discord 频道，该怎么做？
say.note: 按步骤指导创建应用、粘贴 Token 并重启。

say.text: 在 /setup 里加上 Discord 通道。

howto.what_en: After this skill is applied, the service copies and registers the Discord adapter from the channels branch, installs a pinned dependency, builds, and runs an integration test. You then manually create the bot and paste its token; after restart, the bot can DM you or post in shared servers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Discord integration or a Discord channel, or during /setup when connecting Discord.

say_en.text: Connect the Discord bot for me.
I want to enable Discord channel, how?
say_en.note: Steps through creating an app, pasting token, and restarting.
After it finishes, return to setup or wire with /init-first-agent.
